confirmedDefect.before: One five-second deadline covers waiting for worker authentication, writing the reserved unbound stop, and waiting for native retirement. The child instead starts its own five-second receipt deadline after consuming the stop.
confirmedDefect.baseline: Fails with ErrRecovery and pipe timeout although native cleanup completes within its own bound.
confirmedDefect.correction: Rearm the service deadline only after its authenticated reserved stop has been written. Authentication and stop delivery retain the initial five-second bound; exact retirement receipt gets a fresh five-second bound matching the child.
confirmedDefect.preserved: No input lease is issued here. Keep exact authenticated receipt validation, owned job lifetime, pending retirement fence, native exit requirement, and timeout failure behavior.
confirmedDefect.attributionLimit: The field failure has a matching missing-receipt stage, but lacks per-phase durations. The race is reproduced and fixed; this does not prove it caused every recovery or the cursor latency.

remaining.trace: Saved locally in ignored .cache/rollouts/g452/analysis/runtime-stall.trace; do not commit raw traces or support reports.
remaining.traceLimit: The retained trace begins around the failure and contains diagnostic receipt processing. Its later approximately 7.3-second concurrent GC cycle is not a seven-second stop-the-world pause and cannot explain an earlier failure by itself.

validation.additionalBoundaries: Slow authentication still times out; oversized cleanup still times out; receipt deadline setup failure preserves ErrRecovery and does not consume the receipt.
